mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have a comfortable 69 degrees with clear skies at Badger Ridge Middle School, and with the First Quarter moon, it will be a great night to spot the International Space Station at 10:22 PM as it travels from Cross Plains toward the Oregon area near Costco, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The city offers several resources for residents, including the VHAT cable channel for government meetings and information on proper vehicle storage, which requires parking on impervious surfaces at least 5 feet from property lines. Additionally, you can help the environment by using the free Food Scrap Stop program located at Badger Prairie County Park.

There is plenty to do this week. Today, you can visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, enjoy Pizza and a Pitcher at the Wisconsin Brewing Company, or join trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, look forward to Concerts in the Park at Century School Park and Hop Haus trivia.
Looking at the weekly report, on July 13, officers responded to a situation where a driver was arrested for an O-W-I after their vehicle became trapped on a large rock.
You are in for a treat with today's flavor, Mint Explosion. You have plenty of time to enjoy a scoop since the store is open until 10:00 PM.
